blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ
blocks.zh: 分明的视觉符号以类似于语言的离散形式代表了视觉,在共同的下个预测目标下为多式联运模型提供了本土界面。 然而,大量认为量化错误会造成不可避免的语义损失,从根本上限制了离散视觉符号的语义忠诚性,并将连续视觉表现定位为内在的上界. 使用多模式理解作为语义忠诚的代名词,我们重新审视这一假设,发现量化错误不可靠,因为有大得多错误的离散表达可以实现更好的理解. 相反,离散指数的有效比特预算是下游业绩的一个关键决定因素。 然而,现有的四分解器最终会饱和,因为额外的编码本会逐渐减少语义信息. 作为缓解这种饱和性的一种方法,我们引入了因果化的矢量分量法,它用对称并列的密码本来将视觉特征的互补的,固定维度的视角进行量化. 它在更大位预算方面继续改进,最终与多式联运中持续的视觉表现相匹配。 在工业规模的多模式数据培训方面,我们的模型在离散代表模型中取得了最先进的业绩,在9度平均比UniAR和Emu3-Chat分别高出22.8%和59.2%。 据我们所知,这也是第一个独立代表模式,具有强大的连续代表模式,如Qune3-VL,包括精细的OCR任务。 我们进一步确定了促进这种竞争力的关键原则和实际办法。 这些成果和见解支持了分散的视觉表现支持大规模本土多模式基础模型的潜力。 守则和模型见https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent multimodal models are moving beyond the conventional pipeline of attaching a standalone vision encoder to a language model through approaches such as early-fusion pretraining ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) and encoder-free designs ( Diao et al., 2024 ; Diao et al., 2025 ; Diao et al., 2026 ) . More ambitiously, recent work pursues the grand unification of multimodal modeling by representing images as discrete tokens analogous to text ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Geng et al., 2025 ; Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2026 ) . By bringing vision and language under a shared token interface, this formulation allows multimodal models to inherit the mature architectures, training paradigms, and scaling recipes of LLMs.
Beyond serving as a common modeling interface, discrete visual representations can also function as visual chains of thought ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) or intermediate semantic representations ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , providing explicit guidance for image generation, spatial understanding, and depth estimation within unified multimodal models.
blocks.zh:
近期的多式联运模式正在超越传统管道,即通过早期聚变预训(Quen Team,2026年;Kimi Team等人,2026年)和无编码器设计(Diao等人,2024年;Diao等人,2025年;Diao等人,2026年)。 更雄心勃勃的是,最近的工作是通过将图象作为类似于文字的离散符号来追求多式联运模型的大统一(Wang等人,2024a); Geng等人,2025年;Meituan LongCat Team等人,2026年). 通过将视觉和语言置于一个共同的符号界面之下,这种配制使得多式联运模式能够继承LLMs的成熟架构,培训范式,以及缩放配方.
除了作为通用的模型界面外,离散的视觉表达还可以起到视觉思维链的作用(杨等人,2026年;孙等人,2026年)或中间语义表达(王等人,2026年),为统一的多式联运模型内的图像生成,空间理解,深度估计提供明确的指导.

blocks.en: However, quantizing continuous visual features into a finite codebook inevitably incurs quantization error, which is widely assumed to entail semantic loss. Under this view, discrete representations cannot serve as a semantically faithful proxy for the original visual signal, making continuous visual representations a natural upper bound on downstream performance.
blocks.zh: 然而,将连续的视觉特征量化为有限编码本,不可避免地会发生量化错误,人们普遍认为这会导致语义损失。 在这种观点下,离散的表达不能成为原始视觉信号的精致忠实的代称,使连续的视觉表达成为下游性能的自然上方约束.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Scaling the bit budget of discrete visual representations. (a) Average multimodal understanding performance improves with the per-patch bit budget. FVQ continues to improve in the high-budget regime and reaches the continuous QwenViT baseline, whereas existing multi-codebook quantizers saturate. (b) Qualitative examples of text recognition at increasing bit budgets. Higher budgets progressively recover the fine-grained textual information required for correct predictions; green and red denote correct and incorrect answers, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图1: 放大离散视觉表现的比特预算。 (a) 平均多式联运理解性能随着每平方位预算而改善。 FVQ继续改进高预算制度,达到连续的QuenViT基线,而现有的多编码四聚体饱和。 (b) 在增加单项预算时确认文本的定性实例。 较高的预算逐步收回正确预测所需的精细文字信息;绿色和红色分别表示正确和不正确的答案。

blocks.en: In this work, we challenge this common assumption. We use multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, since a representation that provides the information needed to answer any image-centric question can be regarded as semantically lossless with respect to the original visual signal ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2026 ) . Our experiments reveal that a discrete representation with an order-of-magnitude larger quantization error can nevertheless achieve substantially better understanding performance. This result demonstrates that quantization error is not a reliable measure of semantic fidelity, raising a fundamental question: What determines the semantic fidelity of discrete visual representations?
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们对这一共同的假设提出质疑。 我们使用多式联运理解作为语义忠诚的代名词,因为提供回答任何以图像为中心的问题所需的信息的代表可以被视为对原始视觉信号的无意识损失(Meituan LongCat Team等人,2026年)。 我们的实验表明,如果一个离散的表示法出现较大的量化误差,则可以大大增进对性能的理解。 这一结果表明,量化错误不是衡量语义忠诚的可靠尺度,提出了一个根本性的问题: 什么决定了离散视觉表现的语义忠诚性?

blocks.en: Returning to first principles, raw visual signals, continuous features, and discrete representations are all finite-bit encodings in digital systems, whose nominal capacities can be characterized by their bit budgets, as illustrated in Fig. 2 (right). The semantic content of raw visual signals can in principle be represented with far fewer bits owing to their high redundancy, suggesting that discrete representations may approach semantic completeness with a sufficiently large bit budget. For discrete representations, the bit budget grows linearly with the number of codebooks L L but only logarithmically with the size of each codebook C C , making multi-codebook quantization a more efficient scaling strategy. To test this hypothesis, we systematically scale the bit budget and observe steady improvements in downstream multimodal understanding, as shown in Fig. 1 (a).
blocks.zh: 回归第一原理,原始视觉信号,连续特征,以及离散的表示都是数字系统中的有限位编码,其名义能力可以其位预算为特征,如图2(右)所示. 原始视觉信号的语义内容由于冗余度高,原则上可以用少得多的比特表示,这表明离散的表示可能以足够大的比特预算接近语义完整性. 对于离散的表示,比特预算随着编码本的数量LL的线性增长,但仅与每个编码本CC的大小对数,使得多编码本的量化成为更有效率的缩放策略. 为了检验这一假设,我们系统地扩大比特预算,并观察到下游多式联运理解的稳步改善,如图1(a)所示。

blocks.en: However, existing multi-codebook quantizers face a scaling bottleneck as additional codebooks become less semantically informative. Residual vector quantization (RVQ) ( Lee et al., 2022 ) assigns later codebooks to progressively smaller residuals, whereas product quantization (PQ) ( Jégou et al., 2011 ; Ma et al., 2026a ) partitions the feature into increasingly narrow channel groups. Consequently, the effective semantic capacity fails to keep pace with the nominal bit budget, limiting further scaling.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的多码本四分解器面临一个缩放瓶颈,因为额外的密码本在内容上变得不那么丰富。 残余矢量定量(RVQ)(Lee等人,2022年)将后来的编码本分配给逐渐缩小的残余物,而产品定量(PQ)(Jégou等人,2011年;Ma等人,2026a年)则将特性划分为日益狭窄的信道组。 因此,有效的语义能力无法跟上名义位预算,限制了进一步规模化。

blocks.en: The observed saturation motivates quantizer designs that continue to provide newly added codebooks with informative views as the bit budget grows. As one approach to alleviating this bottleneck, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization (FVQ), illustrated in Fig. 3 , which constructs complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the same visual feature and quantizes them with symmetric parallel codebooks. Fig. 1 (a) shows that FVQ continues to improve with larger bit budgets after RVQ and PQ saturate, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding.
blocks.zh: 观测到的饱和度激发了量子设计,随着比特预算的增长,这些量子设计继续为新添加的编码本提供信息视图. 作为缓解这一瓶颈的一个方法,我们引入了FVQ(FVQ),如图3所示,它构建了对同一视觉特征的互补、固定维度的视图,并用对称的平行代码表加以量化。 图1(a)显示,在RVQ和PQ饱和度之后,FVQ在更大位预算的情况下继续改进,最终匹配了多式联运中的连续视觉表现.

blocks.en: Moving beyond small-scale feasibility studies, we train our model on industrial-scale multimodal data. The resulting model achieves competitive performance with flagship multimodal models across a broad suite of benchmarks, demonstrating the data scalability of discrete visual representations and supporting their potential to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models.
blocks.zh: 除了小规模可行性研究之外,我们还就工业规模的多式联运数据培训我们的模型。 由此产生的模型实现了具有竞争力的绩效,旗舰式多式联运模型跨越了广泛的一套基准,显示了离散视觉表现的数据可扩展性,支持它们支持大规模本土多式联运基础模型的潜力。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows. • We show that quantization error does not determine semantic fidelity. Starting from the first-principles observation that digital RGB images are themselves discrete finite-bit signals, we further demonstrate that a sufficiently large effective bit budget enables discrete representations to match continuous ones in downstream understanding. • We introduce Factorized Vector Quantization (FVQ), which provides one approach to alleviating the high-budget saturation observed in existing multi-codebook quantizers. FVQ quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the same visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks and sustains gains as the bit budget increases. • We demonstrate the data scalability of our model through industrial-scale multimodal training, achieving state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models with relative improvements of 22.8% over UniAR and 59.2% over Emu3-Chat on a nine-metric average. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first discrete-representation model to achieve competitive performance against flagship continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL. Beyond these empirical results, we distill the key principles and a practical recipe that make such competitiveness possible, further supporting the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下。 我们显示,量化错误不能决定语义上的忠诚。 从第一个原则观察数字RGB图像本身是离散的有限位信号开始,我们进一步表明,足够大的有效位预算使离散的表示能够与下游理解中的连续表示相匹配。 我们引入了因果化矢量量化法(FVQ),它为缓解现有多码分解器中观察到的高预算饱和度提供了一种方法. FVQ 将同一视觉特征的互补的,固定维度的视图与对称的平行代码簿进行量化,并随着位预算的增加而保持收益. ^ . 我们通过工业规模的多式联运培训,展示我们模型的数据可扩展性,实现离散代表模型的最新性能,平均比UniAR提高22.8%,比Emu3-Chat提高59.2%。 据我们所知,我们是第一个与Qune3-VL等旗舰连续代表模式竞争的离散代表模式。 除了这些实证成果外,我们提炼出使这种竞争力成为可能的关键原则和一种实际办法,进一步支持分散的视觉表现作为大规模本土多式联运基础模型基础的潜力。

Starting from the first-principles observation that digital RGB images are themselves discrete finite-bit signals, we further demonstrate that a sufficiently large effective bit budget enables discrete representations to match continuous ones in downstream understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,量化错误不能决定语义上的忠诚。 从数字RGB图像本身是离散的有限位信号的第一条原则观察开始,我们进一步表明,足够大的有效位预算能够使离散的表示与下游理解中的连续表示相匹配。

FVQ quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the same visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks and sustains gains as the bit budget increases.

blocks.en: We demonstrate the data scalability of our model through industrial-scale multimodal training, achieving state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models with relative improvements of 22.8% over UniAR and 59.2% over Emu3-Chat on a nine-metric average. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first discrete-representation model to achieve competitive performance against flagship continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL. Beyond these empirical results, we distill the key principles and a practical recipe that make such competitiveness possible, further supporting the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models.
blocks.zh: 我们通过工业规模的多式联运培训,展示我们模型的数据可扩展性,实现离散代表模型的最新性能,平均比UniAR提高22.8%,比Emu3-Chat提高59.2%。 据我们所知,我们是第一个与Qune3-VL等旗舰连续代表模式竞争的离散代表模式。 除了这些实证成果外,我们提炼出使这种竞争力成为可能的关键原则和一种实际办法,进一步支持分散的视觉表现作为大规模本土多式联运基础模型基础的潜力。

blocks.en: 2 What Determines the Semantics of Discrete Visual Representations?
blocks.zh: 2 什么决定了视界的语义?

blocks.en: Discrete visual representations provide a shared token interface for vision and language, enabling native multimodal modeling and visual chains of thought while potentially reducing modality conflicts. Their limited semantic fidelity, however, remains a central bottleneck. We therefore investigate what governs the semantic fidelity of discrete visual representations. Section 2.1 tests whether quantization error necessarily implies semantic loss, and Section 2.2 examines effective bit budget and the scaling bottlenecks of existing quantizers. Fig. 2 summarizes the two analyses.
blocks.zh: 细微的视觉表现为视觉和语言提供了一个共同的符号界面,使本地的多式联运模式和视觉思维链成为可能减少模式冲突。 然而,它们的语义忠诚度有限,仍然是一个核心瓶颈。 因此,我们调查了对离散视觉表现的语义忠诚性有何规定。 第2.1节检验量化错误是否必然意味着语义损失,第2.2节检查有效的位预算和现有量化器的缩放瓶颈. 图2概述了这两项分析。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the analyses in Section 2 : reconstruction error versus semantic fidelity (left) and bit-budget scaling across representative quantizers (right). B raw B_{\mathrm{raw}} , B cont B_{\mathrm{cont}} , and B disc B_{\mathrm{disc}} denote per-patch budgets for raw pixels, continuous features, and discrete indices. f f , n n , V V , b b , D D , L L , and C C denote patch side length, channels, values per channel, bits per feature dimension, feature dimension, number of codebooks, and codebook size, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图2:第2节中的分析概述:重建错误与语义忠诚(左)和比特预算在具有代表性的四分法(右)。 B 原始 B_{\mathrm{raw}}, Bcont B_{\mathrm{cont}}, B盘 B_{\mathrm{disc}} 表示原始像素,连续特征和离散指数的每个patch预算. f, n, V V, b b, D D, L L,和 C C分别表示补丁侧长度,通道,每个通道的值,每个特征维度的位数,特征维度,代码本的数量,以及代码本大小.

blocks.en: 2.1 Rethinking Quantization Error and Semantic Fidelity
blocks.zh: 2.1 重新思考量化错误和语义微妙性

blocks.en: Finding 1: Quantization Error Does Not Determine Semantic Fidelity. Representations with similar errors can exhibit substantially different understanding performance, whereas those with markedly different errors can retain comparable semantic information.
blocks.zh: 发现 1: 量化错误不能确定语义Fidelity 。 存在类似错误的表述可以表现出截然不同的理解性能,而有明显不同错误的表述可以保留可比较的语义信息。

blocks.en: In this section, we challenge the common assumption that continuous visual representations form an intrinsic upper bound for their discrete counterparts. A prevailing view holds that mapping continuous visual features to a finite codebook inevitably introduces quantization error and that this distortion necessarily entails semantic loss. Under this view, discrete representations are inherently weaker than continuous ones.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们质疑一种共同的假设,即连续的视觉表现构成其离散对应物的内在的上方束缚。 一种普遍的看法认为,将连续的视觉特征映射到一个有限的编码本上,不可避免地会引入量化错误,而这种扭曲必然会造成语义损失. 这种观点认为,离散的表述本质上比连续的表述要弱。

blocks.en: However, the VLM operates on discrete indices rather than reconstructed features, so quantization error need not translate directly into reduced semantic fidelity. We compare single-codebook VQ ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ) with eight-group RVQ and construct two partial representations by retaining alternating groups. Fig. 2 (left) highlights the odd-group comparison, while Table 1 reports feature-reconstruction MSE on the ImageNet validation set ( Deng et al., 2009 ) alongside downstream multimodal understanding performance for all variants.
blocks.zh: 然而,VLM运行于离散指数而不是重建特征,因此量化错误不需要直接转化为降低语义忠诚度. 我们将单码本VQ(van den Oord et al., 2017)与八组RVQ进行比较,并通过保留交替组来构建两个部分代表. 图2(左)着重显示了奇数组的比较,而表1则报告在ImageNet验证集(Deng等人,2009年)上,所有变体的下游多式联运理解性能。

blocks.en: Table 1: Quantization error and multimodal understanding of discrete QwenViT representations. C C and L L denote the codebook size and number of selected codebooks, respectively. MSE measures feature-reconstruction error. Avg. is the unweighted mean over the eight benchmarks, with OCRBench divided by 10.
blocks.zh: 表1:离散的QuenViT表示的量化错误和多式联运理解. C C和L L分别表示所选密码本的代码大小和编号. MSE测量特征重建错误. Avg.是8个基准之上的未加权平均值,OCR Bench除以10.

blocks.en: The results reveal a counterintuitive pattern. Although the odd-group variant omits the coarse component captured by group 0 and incurs substantially greater reconstruction error, it markedly outperforms VQ and performs comparably to the even-group variant in understanding performance. Conversely, the even-group variant exhibits reconstruction error comparable to VQ but achieves much stronger understanding. Together, these contrasting cases show that reconstruction error does not determine semantic fidelity, raising a more fundamental question: what governs the semantic capacity of a discrete representation?
blocks.zh: 结果揭示出一种反直觉模式. 虽然奇群变体省略了第0组捕获的粗体元件,并发生了大得多的重建错误,但它在理解性能时明显优于VQ,并具有与偶群变体的可比性. 反之,偶数组变体显示出与VQ相当的重建错误,但实现了更强烈的理解. 这些对比性案例加在一起表明重建错误不能决定语义的忠诚性,提出了一个更根本的问题:一个离散代表的语义能力受什么支配?

blocks.en: 2.2 Bit-Budget Scaling in Discrete Visual Representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 分散视觉表现的比特预算缩放

blocks.en: Finding 2: Larger Bit Budgets Improve Semantic Capacity When Added Codes Remain Informative. Increasing the discrete bit budget improves semantic fidelity and downstream multimodal understanding, ultimately enabling discrete representations to match the understanding performance of continuous visual representations.
blocks.zh: 发现 2: 大位预算 当添加代码时, 提高语义能力 。 增加离散比特预算可提高语义忠诚度和下游多式联运理解,最终使离散表示能够与持续视觉表现的理解性能相匹配。

blocks.en: Returning to first principles, raw visual signals, continuous features, and discrete representations are all finite-bit encodings in digital systems, and their nominal capacities can be characterized by their per-patch bit budgets ( Yu et al., 2026a ) , as summarized in Fig. 2 (right). The semantic content of raw visual signals can in principle be represented with far fewer bits owing to their high redundancy. Accordingly, we hypothesize that increasing the discrete bit budget improves semantic fidelity, provided that the additional codes remain semantically informative.
blocks.zh: 回归第一原理,原始视觉信号,连续特征,和离散的表示都是数字系统中的有限位编码,其名义能力可以以其每平方位预算(Yu et al., 2026a)为特征,如图2(右)所总结. 原始视觉信号的语义内容由于冗余度高,原则上可以用少得多的位表示. 因此,我们假设,增加离散的比特预算可以提高语义上的忠诚性,只要增加的代码保持翔实的信息。

blocks.en: To test this hypothesis, we scale the discrete bit budget and evaluate the resulting representations on downstream multimodal understanding tasks. The discrete bit budget B disc = L ​ log 2 ​ C B_{\mathrm{disc}}=L\log_{2}C grows linearly with the number of codebooks L L but only logarithmically with the codebook size C C . Larger codebooks are more difficult to optimize and may suffer from poor utilization or codebook collapse. Keeping the codebook size fixed while increasing the number of codebooks therefore provides a more efficient and tractable scaling strategy. We compare RVQ with product quantization (PQ) ( Jégou et al., 2011 ; Ma et al., 2026a ) , which partitions each feature into channel groups and quantizes them in parallel. Fig. 1 (a) shows that both methods improve as the bit budget increases and progressively approach the continuous representation. This trend also extends to OCR, where discrete representations often struggle because quantization can discard high-frequency details ( Yu et al., 2026b ) . Larger budgets progressively recover the fine-grained textual information required for correct predictions, as shown in Fig. 1 (b). Detailed benchmark results are reported in Table 2 .

blocks.en: Despite this trend, both RVQ and PQ saturate at high bit budgets. Increasing the number of codebooks from 8 to 16 doubles the nominal bit budget but yields only marginal gains in understanding performance. We attribute this saturation to diminishing information per codebook, as later RVQ groups receive weaker residuals and PQ partitions features into increasingly narrow channel groups. The nominal capacity therefore grows without a corresponding increase in effective semantic capacity, showing that additional bits help only when the added codes remain semantically informative. This observation motivates quantizer designs that continue to provide informative representations to newly added codebooks as their number grows. In the next section, we introduce FVQ as one such approach.

blocks.en: 3 From Bit-Budget Scaling to Quantizer Design
blocks.zh: 3 从比特预算缩放到量子设计

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: The preceding analysis shows that a larger nominal bit budget is insufficient when the information available to each codebook diminishes as their number grows. A scalable multi-codebook quantizer should therefore assign symmetric roles to its codebooks, provide each with a fixed-dimensional view derived from the full feature, and collectively preserve the original feature before quantization. Guided by these principles, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization (FVQ) as a concrete realization based on dense tight-frame projections, parallel independent codebooks, and information-preserving synthesis, as illustrated in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 前面的分析显示,当每个编码簿所能得到的信息随着数量的增长而减少时,名义上的比特预算是不够的。 因此,可缩放的多码本四解码器应该为其编码本指定对称角色,为每个代码提供从完整特性衍生出来的固定维度视图,并在四解码前集体保留原特征. 在这些原则的指导下,我们引入了因果化矢量量化(FVQ),作为基于密集的紧框预测、平行的独立代码本以及信息保存合成的具体实现,如图3所示。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Overview of FVQ. During quantizer training, multiple dense projections produce complementary views of the same visual feature, which are quantized in parallel by independent codebooks. The selected codewords are combined through tight-frame synthesis for feature reconstruction. In the subsequent VLM training stage, the quantizer is frozen, and only the resulting discrete indices are mapped to newly initialized token embeddings for multimodal understanding. The nine-metric average is computed over MMMU, MathVista, MMStar, OCRBench/10, ChartQA, CharXiv-DQ, CharXiv-RQ, DocVQA, and InfoVQA.
blocks.zh: 图3:FVQ概览. 在量子化训练中,多重密集的预测会产生对同一视觉特征的补充观点,这些观点由独立的密码本平行地量化. 所选的密码词通过紧框合成组合,用于特征重建. 在随后的VLM培训阶段,量子被冷冻,只有所产生的离散指数被映射到新初始化的代币嵌入,用于多式联运的理解. 9度平均值在MMMU、MathVista、MMStar、OCR Bench/10、ChartQA、CharXiv-DQ、CharXiv-RQ、DocVQA和InfoVQA上计算。

blocks.en: FVQ implements the three design choices described above. First, parallel independent quantization assigns symmetric roles to all codebooks, avoiding the progressively weaker inputs induced by a residual hierarchy. Second, dense projections provide each codebook with a fixed-dimensional view derived from the full feature, so the information available to an individual codebook does not structurally diminish as L L increases. Third, the tight-frame analysis–synthesis pair makes these views collectively information-preserving before quantization. Together, these choices enable the nominal bit budget to scale with L L without structurally reducing the information available to newly added codebooks.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en: We report two training configurations: an industrial-scale configuration for the main experiments and a shared configuration based primarily on the LLaVA-OneVision data ( Li et al., 2024 ) for the exploratory experiments in Section 2 and the ablation studies.
blocks.zh: 我们报告两种培训配置:主要实验的工业规模配置和主要基于LLAVA-One Vision数据(Li等人,2024年)的共享配置,用于第2节中的探索性实验和开发研究。

blocks.en: Our main model pairs Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) with an any-resolution visual tokenizer constructed by applying 16-codebook FVQ to Qwen3 ViT ( Bai et al., 2025a ) . To preserve a native next-token prediction setup with minimal modality-specific modifications to the LLM, we use standard 1D RoPE ( Su et al., 2024 ) in the LLM and omit the DeepStack connections from Qwen3 ViT. Unless otherwise specified, the exploratory and ablation experiments use Qwen3-1.7B and vary the quantization configuration according to the experiment.
blocks.zh: 我国主要型号配对Qwen3-8B(Yang等人,2025年),采用16码本FVQ对Qwen3 VIT(Bai等人,2025a年)进行任意分辨率视觉标注器构造. 为了保留一个本土的下接式预测设置,同时对LLM进行最小模式特定修改,我们在LLM中使用了标准1D RoPE(Su等人,2024年),并省略了Qune3 VIT中的DeepStack连接. 除非另有说明,探索和衰竭实验使用Qune3-1.7B,并随实验的不同而改变定量配置.

blocks.en: Both configurations follow four stages. Quantizer training learns the visual tokenizer by reconstructing frozen visual features. Alignment stage freezes both the tokenizer and the LLM and optimizes the newly initialized visual token embeddings and merger to align the discrete IDs with the language embedding space. Pre-training and supervised fine-tuning both keep the tokenizer frozen and jointly optimize the LLM, visual token embeddings, and merger, using context lengths of 8K and 16K and maximum image resolutions of 1024px and 2048px, respectively.
blocks.zh: 两种配置都遵循四个阶段. 量子训练通过重建冷冻的视觉特征来学习视觉装饰. 对齐阶段既冻结了标致器,也冻结了LLM,优化了新初始化的视觉符号嵌入和合并,使离散的ID与语言嵌入空间一致. 预训和受监督的微调既保持标定器的冷却,又联合优化LLM,视觉标定嵌入,并兼并,使用上下文长度分别为8K和16K,最大图像分辨率分别为1024px和2048px.

blocks.en: For the main experiments, quantizer training, alignment, pre-training, and supervised fine-tuning use 100B, 10B, 60B, and 30B tokens, respectively, drawn from mixtures covering STEM, OCR, interleaved image-text sequences, image captioning and text-only data. For the exploratory and ablation experiments, we train the quantizer on 50B tokens, use approximately 4B tokens for alignment, and adopt LLaVA-OneVision ( Li et al., 2024 ) for pre-training and supervised fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 对于主要实验,定量器训练,对齐,预训,以及监督的微调分别使用100B,10B,60B,和30B符号,分别从覆盖STEM,OCR的混合物中抽取,交互的图像文本序列,图像字幕和仅文本数据. 在探索和消毒实验中,我们用50B代币对量子进行训练,使用约4B代币对齐,并采用LLaVA-One Vision(Li等人,2024年)进行预训和监督微调.

blocks.en: We evaluate general perception and reasoning on MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , its more challenging and robust extension MMMU-Pro ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , MMStar ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , and RealWorldQA ( xAI, 2024 ) . We assess mathematical reasoning on MathVista ( Lu et al., 2024 ) . For text recognition and text-centric understanding, we use OCRBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , OCRBench V2 ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , and TextVQA ( Singh et al., 2019 ) ; for document and infographic understanding, we use DocVQA ( Mathew et al., 2021 ) , InfoVQA ( Mathew et al., 2022 ) , and OmniDocBench ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) , which evaluates document parsing across diverse PDF document types. We assess diagram and chart understanding on AI2D ( Kembhavi et al., 2016 ) with mask, ChartQA ( Masry et al., 2022 ) , and CharXiv ( Wang et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价MMMU(Yue等人,2024年),其更具挑战性和强力的扩展MMU-Pro(Yue等人,2025年),MMStar(Chen等人,2024年a)和RealWorldQA(xAI,2024年)的一般看法和推理。 我们评估关于MathVista的数学推理(Lu等人,2024年). 对于文本识别和文本中心理解,我们使用OCR Bench(Liu等人,2024年),OCR Bench V2(Fu等人,2026年),以及TextVQA(Singh等人,2019年);对于文件和信息理解,我们使用DocVQA(Mathew等人,2021年),InfoVQA(Mathew等人,2022年),以及OmniDoc Bench(Ouyang等人,2025年),它们评价各种PDF文件类型的文档解析. 我们用面具评估AI2D(Kembhavi等人,2016年)和CharXiv(Wang等人,2024年b)的图表和图表理解。

blocks.en: Quantization is commonly thought to discard the high-frequency details required for OCR, document, and chart understanding, causing discrete-representation models to lag substantially behind continuous-representation models ( Yu et al., 2026b ) . blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We revisit the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and show that feature reconstruction error does not reliably predict downstream understanding. Instead, effective bit budget emerges as a key determinant of semantic capacity. However, existing multi-codebook quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute diminishing semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this bottleneck, FVQ combines complementary projections with symmetric parallel codebooks and sustains gains at larger bit budgets. Moving beyond small-scale feasibility studies, our industrial-scale model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models and remains competitive with strong continuous-representation models, including on fine-grained OCR and document understanding. These results support discrete tokens as a scalable interface for large-scale native multimodal foundation models.
blocks.zh: 我们重新审视离散视觉符号的语义忠实,并表明特征重建错误无法可靠地预测下游的理解。 相反,有效的位预算是语义能力的一个关键决定因素。 然而,现有的多编码本的四聚体最终会饱和,因为额外的编码本有助于减少语义信息. 作为缓解这一瓶颈的一个方法,FVQ将互补预测与对称的并行代码簿相结合,并在较大的位数预算中维持收益. 我们的工业规模模型超越了小规模可行性研究,在离散代表模型中实现了最先进的业绩,并且仍然与强大的连续代表模型具有竞争力,包括在精细的OCR和文件理解方面。 这些结果支持将离散符号作为大规模本土多式联运基础模型的可扩展界面。

A.2 Factorized Vector Quantization: Design and Derivation
blocks.zh: A.2 因素化矢量量化:设计和衍生

blocks.en: The analysis in Section 2.2 shows that increasing the number of codebooks expands the nominal bit budget, but does not guarantee a corresponding increase in effective semantic capacity. A scalable multi-codebook quantizer must therefore satisfy three requirements. First, each codebook should receive a fixed-dimensional view derived from the full feature, so its input does not shrink as L L grows. Second, these views should collectively preserve the original feature before quantization, ensuring that the factorization itself does not introduce another information bottleneck. Third, all codebooks should play symmetric roles, so newly added codebooks are not restricted to progressively weaker residuals. These requirements lead to Factorized Vector Quantization (FVQ), which combines dense fixed-dimensional projections, tight-frame synthesis, and symmetric parallel codebooks. Each visual patch is represented by L L indices with a per-patch bit budget of L ​ log 2 ​ C L\log_{2}C .

If the projection matrices are constructed independently without a global constraint, their row spaces may overlap substantially, repeatedly encoding some feature directions while providing little coverage of others. In the extreme case, a direction in the null space of the stacked operator 𝐀 \mathbf{A} disappears from every projected view and cannot be recovered. Even when 𝐀 \mathbf{A} has full column rank, unequal singular values can strongly amplify some directions and attenuate others, yielding a poorly conditioned representation whose geometry is difficult to recover. The dimensional requirement L ​ d ≥ D Ld\geq D makes full-rank recovery possible, but does not by itself guarantee uniform or stable coverage. blocks.en: Appendix B Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录B 相关工作

blocks.en: B.1 Native and Unified Multimodal Modeling
blocks.zh: B.1 本土和统一多式联运模式

blocks.en: Multimodal foundation models are moving beyond the conventional paradigm of attaching a vision encoder and lightweight adapter to a pretrained language model. Recent work pursues more native multimodal modeling along two complementary directions. The first adopts early-fusion pretraining, introducing multimodal data from the outset of language-model pretraining, as exemplified by Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and Kimi K3 ( Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) . The second integrates visual processing directly into the multimodal backbone, reducing the architectural separation between vision and language. EVE ( Diao et al., 2024 ) , EVEv2 ( Diao et al., 2025 ) , Mono-InternVL ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , and SenseNova-U1 ( Diao et al., 2026 ) pursue encoder-free or monolithic designs, while TML-Interaction ( Thinking Machines Lab, 2026 ) combines encoder-free processing with early-fusion pretraining for real-time multimodal interaction. These approaches pursue native multimodality by changing when multimodal learning begins or where visual processing occurs.
blocks.zh: 多式联运基础模型正在超越传统模式,即将视觉编码器和轻量级适配器附加到预先训练的语言模型中。 最近的工作是沿着两个相辅相成的方向发展更多的本土多式联运模式。 第一种是采用早期聚变预训,从语言模式预训一开始就引入多式联运数据,例如Quen3.5(Quen Team,2026年)和Kimi K3(Kimi Team等人,2026年). 第二部直接将视觉处理整合到多式联运骨干中,减少了视觉和语言的建筑区分. EVE(Diao et al., 2024),EVEv2(Diao et al., 2025),Mono-InternVL(Luo et al., 2025),SenseNova-U1(Diao et al., 2026)追求无编码或单式设计,而TML-Interaction(Winking Machines Lab, 2026)则将无编码处理与早期核聚变预训相结合,用于实时多模式互动. 这些办法追求本土多式联运,办法是在开始学习多式联运时或在进行视觉处理时发生变化。

blocks.en: A complementary line of work pursues unification at the representation level. Chameleon ( Chameleon Team, 2024 ) and Emu3 ( Wang et al., 2024a ) represent images as discrete tokens and model vision and language under a shared autoregressive objective. X-Omni ( Geng et al., 2025 ) uses a shared semantic image-token space for understanding and generation, with a diffusion decoder translating predicted tokens into images. LongCat-Next ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2026 ) lexicalizes arbitrary-resolution visual inputs through hierarchical discrete codes, while UniAR ( Peng et al., 2026 ) uses a shared visual tokenizer to connect multimodal understanding and generation. Beyond unifying understanding and generation, visual representations can also serve as intermediate computational states. Representation Forcing autoregressively predicts visual representations before pixels and retains them in context to guide pixel-space diffusion ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Context Unrolling enables explicit reasoning across multiple modal representations before producing predictions ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . VoT generates discrete visual-plan tokens, such as objects and layouts, to bridge high-level semantics and pixel rendering ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Together, these works establish discrete visual tokens as a promising interface for native and unified multimodal models ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) . Complementary work improves multimodal understanding through generative imagination for human–object interaction ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) and tool-assisted action recognition ( Yuan et al., 2026a ) . Our work addresses the representation bottleneck underlying this interface by studying what determines the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and how that capacity can be scaled.
blocks.zh: 一种互补的工作方针是在代表一级实现统一。 Chameleon (Chameleon Team, 2024)和Emu3(Wang et al., 2024a)在共同的自递目标下,将图像作为离散符号和模型视觉和语言来表示. X-Omni(Geng等人,2025年)使用共享的语义图像托盘空间进行理解和生成,并配有扩散解码器,将预测的代号翻译为图像. 长 Cat- Next (美通长凯特) Team et al.,2026)通过分级离散代码将任意分辨率的视觉输入语化,而UniAR(Peng et al.,2026)则使用共享的视觉示意器连接多式联运理解和生成. 除了统一理解和生成外,视觉表达还可以作为中间计算状态. 表示力强化自动预测像素前的视觉表现,并保留在上下文中以引导像素-空间传播(Wang et al., 2026). 在作出预测之前,“不滚动”使多种模式表述具有明确的理由(Yang等人,2026年)。 VOT生成离散的视觉平面符号,如物体和布局,以桥接高级语义和像素渲染(Sun等人,2026年). 这些作品共同建立了离散的视觉符号,作为本土和统一多式联运模式的有希望的界面(周等人,2025年;陈等人,2025年;马等人,2025年;邓等人,2025年;谢等人,2025年;吴等人,2025年;邹等人,2025年). 补充工作通过人与物相互作用的遗传想象(袁等人,2026年b)和工具辅助行动识别(袁等人,2026年a)改进了对多式联运的理解。 我们的工作通过研究决定离散视觉符号的语义忠诚性以及如何扩大这种能力,解决这一界面背后的表达瓶颈。

blocks.en: B.2 Semantic Visual Representations and Tokenization
blocks.zh: B.2 语义视觉表现和托肯化

blocks.en: Pretrained vision-language encoders provide the semantic feature spaces that modern visual tokenizers seek to discretize. CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) learns transferable visual representations through contrastive language supervision, while SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) improves the scalability of image-text alignment through a pairwise sigmoid objective. SigLIP2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) further strengthens semantic understanding, localization, and dense visual features.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的视觉语言编码器提供了现代视觉示意器所寻求的光碟化的语义特征空间. CLIP(Radford等人,2021年)通过对比性语言监督学习可转移的视觉表现,而SigLIP(Zhai等人,2023年)则通过双智的sigmoid目标提高图像文本对齐的可扩展性. SigLIP2(Tschannn等人,2025年)进一步加强语义理解,本地化,密集的视觉特征.

blocks.en: More recent VLM-oriented vision encoders, including Qwen3 ViT ( Bai et al., 2025a ) , MoonViT-v2 ( Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) , and InternViT ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) , are trained on large-scale task-oriented multimodal data covering OCR, document understanding, and visual question answering. Compared with CLIP-style image-text alignment, this richer supervision yields more fine-grained visual representations that better preserve textual, spatial, and structural information.
blocks.zh: 更近期的VLM面向视觉编码器,包括Qune3 VIT(Bai等人,2025a),MoonViT-v2(Kimi) Team等人,2026年),以及实习生ViT. (Zhu等人,2025a),接受大规模面向任务的多式联运数据培训,涵盖OCR,文档理解和视觉问答. 与CLIP风格的图像-文本对齐相比,这种更丰富的监督产生更精细的视觉表现,更好地保存文字,空间和结构信息.

blocks.en: These semantically structured continuous features provide a natural target space for visual tokenization. RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) uses pretrained VFM features directly as continuous latents, demonstrating their suitability for reconstruction and generation. UniTok ( Ma et al., 2026a ) combines reconstruction with semantic supervision to support both understanding and generation. ViQ ( Yu et al., 2026b ) introduces text-aligned, position-aware quantization, while dRAE ( Ma et al., 2026b ) uses hyperspherical codes that better match the geometry of pretrained features.
blocks.zh: 这些精密结构的连续特征为视觉示标提供了天然的目标空间. RAE(Zheng等人,2026年)直接使用经过预先训练的VFM特征作为连续的潜质,表明它们适合重建和生成. UniTok (Ma et al., 2026a) 将重建与语义监督相结合,以支持理解和生成. ViQ (Yu et al., 2026b)引入文本对齐,位置意识的量化,而dRAE (Ma et al., 2026b)则使用更符合预受训练特征几何的超球形编码.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, discrete visual representations continue to lag substantially behind continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. This persistent gap motivates us to study what governs the semantic information retained when continuous features are mapped to finite discrete indices. We isolate this process within a frozen VFM feature space and use downstream multimodal understanding to evaluate the resulting representations. Our analysis shifts attention from reconstruction quality alone to the semantic information carried by discrete indices.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但单向的视觉表现仍然远远落后于多式联运中持续的视觉表现。 这一持续的差距促使我们研究在将连续特征绘制成有限的离散指数时所保留的语义信息。 我们把这一进程隔离在一个冻结的VFM空间内,并利用下游的多式联运理解来评价由此产生的表述。 我们的分析将注意力从重建质量转移到由离散指数携带的语义信息。

blocks.en: B.3 Quantized Visual Encoders
blocks.zh: B.3 量化视觉编码器

blocks.en: Vector quantization maps continuous features to entries in a finite codebook ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ) . Recent methods improve the optimization and utilization of this discrete space from different perspectives. FSQ ( Mentzer et al., 2024 ) , LFQ ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , and BSQ ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) replace unconstrained learned codebooks with structured scalar or binary codes, while SimVQ ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) and IBQ ( Shi et al., 2025 ) improve the learning and utilization of explicit codebooks.
blocks.zh: 矢量量化图将连续特性映射到有限编码本(van den)中的条目 Oord et al., 2017 ) (中文(中国大陆) ). 最近的方法从不同角度改进了这一离散空间的优化和利用。 FSQ(Mentzer等人,2024年),LFQ(Yu等人,2024年),BSQ(Zhao等人,2025年)用结构化的scalar或二进制代码取代不受约束的学习代码,而SimVQ(Zhu等人,2025年b)和IBQ(Shi等人,2025年)则改进了明确代码的学习和使用.

blocks.en: A complementary line of work expands representation capacity through multiple codebooks. Residual vector quantization recursively encodes the residual left by preceding codebooks ( Lee et al., 2022 ) , while product quantization partitions each feature into independent channel groups, as adopted by UniTok for visual generation and understanding ( Jégou et al., 2011 ; Ma et al., 2026a ) . However, their gains can saturate as the number of codebooks grows. Our work studies this limitation in semantic visual representations and presents FVQ as one approach to sustaining scaling through fixed-dimensional full-feature views and symmetric parallel codebooks.
blocks.zh: 一个互补的工作领域通过多种编码扩展了代表能力. 残余矢量定量递归编码了先前的编码本(Lee等人,2022年)留下的残余物,而产品定量分区则将每个特性分为独立的信道组,由UniTok采用,用于视觉生成和理解(Jégou等人,2011年;Ma等人,2026a年)。 然而,随着密码本数量的增长,它们的收益可以饱和. 我们的工作研究了语义视觉表达的这种局限性,并将FVQ作为通过固定维度全度视图和对称平行代码本来维持缩放的一种方法.

blocks.en: C.1 Additional Experimental Details
blocks.zh: C.1 其他实验细节

blocks.en: Our model follows four sequential stages: tokenizer training, alignment, pre-training (PT), and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Tokenizer training initializes from Qwen3-VL-8B ViT and optimizes the input projection, codebooks, and feature decoder while keeping the tight-frame projections fixed, reconstructing frozen visual features for 100B tokens. Alignment freezes both the tokenizer and the LLM and trains the visual token embeddings and merger for 10B tokens. PT then unfreezes the LLM and jointly optimizes it with the visual interface for 60B tokens while keeping the tokenizer frozen. SFT continues to optimize the LLM and visual interface for 30B tokens with the tokenizer frozen. All four stages use AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 and β 2 = 0.96 \beta_{2}=0.96 . Table 7 summarizes the remaining hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 我们的模式分为四个相继阶段:象征性培训、调整、培训前培训和监督微调。 Tokenizer训练从Qune3-VL-8B VIT初始化,并优化输入投影,代码本,和特征解码器,同时保持紧帧投影的固定,为100B令牌重建冷冻的视觉特性. 对齐既冻结了标致器,也冻结了LLM,并训练了10B令牌的视觉令牌嵌入和合并. PT随后解冻LLM,与60B令牌的视觉界面共同优化,同时保持标致器的冷却. SFT继续优化LLM和可视界面,用于30B令牌,并使用标致器冷冻. 所有四个阶段都使用亚当W(Loshchilov和Hutter,2017年),其中β 1=0.9\βa_{1}=0.9和β 2=0.96\βa_{2}=0.96. 表7汇总了剩余的超参数.

blocks.zh: C.2 额外量化结果

blocks.en: We compare quantization before and after the QwenViT merger, corresponding to spatial downsampling factors of 16 and 32. The former retains the original merger, whereas the latter uses the Pre-Buffer ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2026 ) . Table 8 shows that the 16 × \times configuration performs slightly better overall, suggesting that Pre-Buffer is not essential. Instead, discrete visual embeddings require a learnable transformation that aligns them with the text embedding space, a role already fulfilled by the QwenViT merger when quantization is applied before it.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了QuenViT合并前后的定量,对应16和32的空间下取样系数. 前者保留原兼并,后者则使用预购(Meituan LongCat Team等人,2026年). 表8显示,16×\时配置总体表现略好,说明"预购"并非必要. 相反,离散的视觉嵌入需要一种可学习的转换,使其与文本嵌入空间相配合,这个角色在它面前应用量化时已经由QuenViT合并实现.
